answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The horizon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
